# The paths that never cause work, for every reusable workflow (README,
# Path gates). One glob per line, relative to the repo root: `*` stays inside
# a directory, `**` crosses them. A workflow that ships one of these to its
# output (markdown an image copies in, say) lists it in its caller's
# `work-paths`.
